rainstormReminder.description: Rainstorm Reminder; exact JSON structure is not specified.

tcInfo.description: Tropical Cyclone Information; exact structure is not detailed.

LunarDate.description: Lunar date, in Traditional Chinese only. Example: 二月初十.

PSR.description: Probability of Significant Rain. Documented values include High, Medium High, Medium, Medium Low and Low; this list is not established as exhaustive.

TabularOpenData.description: Generic documented JSON table shape for several climate and weather datasets; fields and values vary by dataset.

data.description: Rows of tabular data; cell types are not specified.

type.description: Dataset type labels, documented for temperature datasets.

depth.description: Depth value for soil temperature where supplied.

value.description: Measurement value; exact JSON wire type is not specified.

Timestamp.description: Timestamp examples use YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ssZ notation and include the +08:00 offset.

subtype.description: Subtype is documented only for fire danger, tropical cyclone and rainstorm warnings. WFIRE: WFIREY (Yellow Fire), WFIRER (Red Fire). WRAIN: WRAINA (Amber), WRAINR (Red), WRAINB (Black). WTCSGNL: TC1 (No. 1), TC3 (No. 3), TC8NE (No. 8 North East), TC8SE (No. 8 South East), TC8SW (No. 8 South West), TC8NW (No. 8 North West), TC9 (No. 9), TC10 (No. 10), CANCEL (Cancel All Signals).

warningStatementCode.description: Warning statement code. Documented codes: WFIRE (Fire Danger Warning), WFROST (Frost Warning), WHOT (Hot Weather Warning), WCOLD (Cold Weather Warning), WMSGNL (Strong Monsoon Signal), WTCPRE8 (Pre-no.8 Special Announcement), WRAIN (Rainstorm Warning Signal), WFNTSA (Special Announcement on Flooding in the northern New Territories), WL (Landslip Warning), WTCSGNL (Tropical Cyclone Warning Signal), WTMW (Tsunami Warning), WTS (Thunderstorm Warning).

actionCode.description: Action code. Documented values include ISSUE, REISSUE (for WCOLD, WHOT and WFNTSA), CANCEL, EXTEND (WTS) and UPDATE (WTS), with applicability depending on warning.

code.description: Warning code or signal subtype code.

expireTime.description: Expiry time, when supplied; this property may be absent.

additionalProperties.description: Potential station/attribute report values; exact value structures are not specified universally.

WeatherRadiationReport.description:
Weather and Radiation Level Report (RYES). The report uses type keys formed from a documented station name and attribute, optionally followed by other-attribute identifiers. Only available attributes are included for each station; unavailable attributes may be omitted or returned as an empty string. Exact values are not uniformly specified.

Publisher RYES dynamic-key dictionaries and availability rule (verbatim retained source; the inline 1 after Attribute is the following footnote, not a wire-key suffix):

Weather and Radiation Level RYES { Report type: data,

type: data, ... type: data, }

Format of "type": {Station} + {Attribute}1 {OtherAttribute}

-----

{Station} list: CheungChau: Cheung Chau ChekLapKok: Chek Lap Kok PingChau: Ping Chau HKO: Hong Kong Observatory HongKongPark: Hong Kong Park WongChukHang: Wong Chuk Hang HappyValley: Happy Valley TseungKwanO: Tseung Kwan O KatO: Kat O KowloonCity: Kowloon City KingsPark: Kings Park KwunTong: Kwun Tong LauFauShan: Lau Fau Shan TaiMeiTuk: Tai Mei Tuk KaiTakRunwayPark: Kai Tak Runway Park ShekKong: Shek Kong ShaTin: Sha Tin SaiKung: Sai Kung ShauKeiWan: Shau Kei Wan ShamShuiPo: Sham Shui Po ShaTauKok: Sha Tau Kok Stanley: Stanley SaiWanHo: Sai Wan Ho TapMun: Tap Mun TsimBeiTsui: Tsim Bei Tsui TaKwuLing: Ta Kwu Ling TaiPo: Tai Po TuenMun: Tuen Mun TsuenWanShingMunValley: Tsuen Wan Shing Mun Valley TsuenWanHoKoon: Tsuen Wan Ho Koon TsingYi: Tsing Yi WongTaiSin: Wong Tai Sin YuenLongPark: Yuen Long Park YuenNgFan: Yuen Ng Fan

-----

{Attribute} list: LocationName: Station MaxTemp: Maximum air temperature (Celsius) ReadingsMaxTemp: Maximum air temperature (Celsius) ReadingsMaxRH: Maximum relative humidity (%) ReadingsAvgRainfall: Average rainfall (mm) ReadingsAccumRainfall: Total rainfall since 1st January (mm) Microsieverts: Average ambient gamma radiation dose rate (microsievert/hour) MinTemp: Minimum air temperature (Celsius) ReadingsMaxUVIndex: Maximum UV index ReadingsMinGrassTemp: Grass minimum temperature (Celsius) ReadingsMinRH: Minimum relative humidity (%) ReadingsRainfall: Rainfall (mm) ReadingsMeanUVIndex: Mean UV index ReadingsSunShine: Duration of sunshine(Hours) ReadingsMinTemp: Minimum air temperature (Celsius)

attributes will not be included or empty string will be returned.

schema.description: CSV output; layouts vary by dataset. For the associated predicted HHOT data file: row 1 is the header; fields 1–2 are MM and DD, and fields 3–26 represent 01:00 through 24:00 HKT. Subsequent rows contain month, day, and predicted astronomical tide height for each hour starting at 01:00 HKT. There are 366 rows, or 367 in a leap year. Time is Hong Kong Time (UTC+8); heights are metres above Chart Datum, 0.146 m below Hong Kong Principal Datum.
